evidence.basis: Written for v0.8 CP6 by the engine's developer from general Portuguese verb classes (transfer verbs with a recipient complement; converse pairs whose roles swap). Not derived from any test sentence; not calibrated against an external lexical resource.
evidence.use: events.frames and compare: recipient_dropped and event_converted. Converse pairs are never treated as antonyms: 'X comprou de Y' and 'Y vendeu para X' say the same thing.
